s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive back pain with radiating pain and spinal cord compression
salient_findings: Back pain radiating to the left side
Intradural extramedullary lesion at T8-T9 level
key_facts: 66-year-old female patient
Osteoporosis
Back pain gradually worsening in recent months
Left nephrectomy due to kidney stones about 1 year ago
Taking alendronate 70 mg once a week for osteoporosis
Normal laboratory tests including serum creatinine, calcium, phosphate, parathyroid hormone, thyrotropin and thyroid hormones
Degenerative changes of the vertebral bodies on lumbar spine X-ray
T-scores of both the lumbar spine and proximal femur were less than -3 on dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry
35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level on MRI
Lesion compressing the spinal cord from posterior with peripheral rim enhancement
Tumor consisted of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern
Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Intradural extramedullary lesion with peripheral rim enhancement and spinal cord compression

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed intradural extramedullary lesion with protein S-100 positivity

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion with peripheral rim enhancement and cystic areas

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Spinal canal mass with degenerative changes and protein S-100 positivity

shortlist.label: Spinal hemangioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Intradural extramedullary lesion with cystic areas and spinal cord compression

raw.rationale: The tumor's characteristics, such as being composed of elongated spindle cells with vesicular nucleus arrayed in a palisade pattern and being diffuse positive for protein S-100, are more consistent with a schwannoma, which is a type of tumor that can arise from the nerve sheath and is known to express S-100 protein.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: While meningiomas can also express S-100, the specific histopathological features and the lack of epithelial membrane antigen expression in this case make schwannoma a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hemangioma
rejected.why: Hemangiomas are typically composed of blood vessels and do not match the histopathological description provided.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Neurofibromas are composed of a mix of cell types including fibroblasts, perineural cells, and mast cells, which does not fit the specific spindle cell pattern described.

rejected.label: Spinal hemangioblastoma
rejected.why: Spinal hemangioblastomas are vascular tumors that typically have a different histological appearance, often with a rich vascular network, which is not described in this case.
